headline.zh: AI 審查回報 Bug 量超越工程師修復極限，PostgreSQL 19 宣布延期
headline.en: PostgreSQL 19 Delayed as AI Code Reviewers Report More Bugs Than Humans Can Fix

detail.zh: 開源資料庫核心團隊在導入 AI 輔助審查後，AI 代理人挖出海量潛在缺陷與極端邊界問題，修復與驗證負載遠超核心維護者的消化能力。這象徵軟體工程正式進入「自動化捉蟲速率超越人類修補吞吐量」的轉折點，社群被迫重新調整開發排程與審查門檻。
detail.en: The PostgreSQL development team delayed version 19 after AI code reviewers flagged an overwhelming volume of bugs and edge cases that outpaced human triage capacity. This highlights a growing software engineering bottleneck where automated bug-finding capability exceeds developer bandwidth for verification and fixing.

headline.zh: PS5LM 釋出：越獄 PS5 可原生執行 llama.cpp 與各類 GGUF 模型
headline.en: PS5LM Brings llama.cpp to Jailbroken PS5 to Run GGUF Models Natively

detail.zh: 開源專案 PS5LM 成功將 llama.cpp 移植至越獄 PlayStation 5 主機，利用其 16GB 統一記憶體直接推論 GGUF 格式的 LLM。這為硬體玩家提供了一個低成本取得大容量統一定址記憶體、用家用主機架設私有推論節點的極客玩法。
detail.en: A new open-source project, PS5LM, ports llama.cpp to jailbroken PlayStation 5 consoles, leveraging their 16GB of unified memory to infer GGUF models directly. It offers developers and homelab enthusiasts an affordable, alternative edge device for self-hosting local language models.

headline.zh: Claude 團隊揭露代碼審查工作流：推動「持續性檢查」取代 PR 守門人機制
headline.en: Anthropic's Claude Code Team Details Continuous AI Code Review Workflow

detail.zh: Anthropic 團隊公開了 Claude Code 的內部實踐，將 Code Review 從傳統發 Pull Request 時的單次審查，轉化為類似拼寫檢查的即時持續檢驗。在代碼交由人類工程師審核之前，AI 已完成多輪修正，大幅壓縮反覆溝通與審核時間。
detail.en: The Claude Code team shared their internal workflow shifts, replacing traditional PR-gate reviews with real-time, continuous AI validation similar to spellchecking. Code changes are typically reviewed and auto-corrected by Claude before human teammates are asked to review, cutting review latencies significantly.

headline.zh: Beam 501B 開源權重釋出：主打高自訂性與自主託管的大規模基礎模型
headline.en: Beam 501B Released: Massive Open-Weights Model for On-Premise Scalability

detail.zh: 社群釋出擁有 5,010 億參數的完全開放模型 Beam，支援從底層自訂微調與獨立架構佈署。專為不願被商用 API 綁定、需要自有龐大模型能力的大型企業與基礎建設團隊設計。
detail.en: The Beam 501B open model has been launched on Hugging Face, offering an unconstrained large-scale foundation model for private infrastructure. It targets teams looking to avoid API vendor lock-in while maintaining maximum customization and scale in-house.

headline.zh: NVIDIA 釋出 2.8 兆 Token 印度語系預訓練管線與合成資料集
headline.en: NVIDIA Opens 2.8T Token Indic Pretraining Pipeline and Synthetic Data Tools

detail.zh: NVIDIA 開源了針對南亞語系大規模預訓練的資料生成與清洗 Pipeline，並公開涵蓋 2.8 兆 Token 的資料架構。該工具鏈解決了低資源語系資料匱乏問題，可用於跨語種資料合成與自建特定語系模型訓練。
detail.en: NVIDIA released an open data generation and pipeline toolkit for scaling pretraining across Indic languages, encompassing 2.8 trillion tokens. The release aids teams handling multilingual and low-resource data synthesis challenges for customized pretraining.

headline.zh: ChatGPT Chrome 擴充功能升級：支援直接讀取與操作瀏覽器分頁上下文
headline.en: ChatGPT Chrome Extension Updated to Directly Access Open Browser Tabs

detail.zh: 在調整瀏覽器原生整合計畫後，OpenAI 升級了 Chrome 擴充功能，使用者在網頁端或桌面端標註 Chrome 時，ChatGPT 即可直接提取並理解當前開啟分頁的內容。大幅減少手動複製貼上網址與上下文的繁瑣操作。
detail.en: OpenAI rolled out Chrome extension updates allowing ChatGPT to read context from open browser tabs whenever users mention Chrome in chats. This streamlines multimodal workflows across web references without needing manual copying of tabs or raw HTML snippets.

headline.zh: Stack Overflow Agent 整合 ChatGPT 外掛：三週打造帶動代理人建立數飆升 10 倍
headline.en: Stack Overflow for Agents Drives 10x Ecosystem Growth via ChatGPT Integration

detail.zh: Stack Overflow 透過 Codex 在數週內快速推出了專為 AI 代理人設計的知識服務平台，並藉由 ChatGPT 外掛支援，使工程師與社群建立的代理人數量迎來 10 倍增長，展現結構化技術論壇內容在 Agentic 時代的轉型路徑。
detail.en: Leveraging Codex, two engineers launched Stack Overflow for Agents in just weeks, with its ChatGPT plugin integration leading to a 10x surge in developer agent creation and programmatic knowledge retrieval.

headline.zh: 首批搭載 NVIDIA RTX Spark Arm 晶片的 Windows 筆電實測出爐
headline.en: First Impressions Land for Laptops Powered by Nvidia's Arm-Based RTX Spark

detail.zh: NVIDIA 針對行動工作站推出的 RTX Spark N1X Arm 晶片筆電開始接受各方評測。該架構結合自研 Arm 核心與行動版 RTX GPU，直接瞄準高能效本地 AI 開發與邊緣推論需求，競爭對手直指 Apple Silicon 與高通平台。
detail.en: Reviews have surfaced for the first wave of laptops running Nvidia's Arm-based RTX Spark N1X SoC. Designed for portable local computing, the chip packs high CPU core counts and Nvidia graphics to challenge Apple and Qualcomm on edge developer workloads.

headline.zh: Anthropic 利用 Claude 逆向解析 ECDSA 橢圓曲線常數的生成根源
headline.en: Anthropic Research Uses Claude to Uncover Historical ECDSA Curve Parameters

detail.zh: Anthropic 發表研究，利用 Claude 的多步驟推理能力逆向工程了標準密碼學中爭議已久的 ECDSA 隨機種子與橢圓曲線常數生成來源。展示了 LLM 在密碼分析、遺留程式碼驗證以及還原黑盒數學構造過程中的潛力。
detail.en: Anthropic published a research piece demonstrating how Claude successfully deduced historical origins and generation procedures behind controversial ECDSA curve seeds. It highlights LLM capabilities in deep cryptographic analysis and legacy code forensics.

headline.zh: 研究指出：美國勞動市場 90% 工時任務未被現有 AI Benchmark 涵蓋
headline.en: Study Reveals 90% of US Working Hours Fall Outside Current AI Benchmarks

detail.zh: Mercor 勞動力地圖研究顯示，現行如 MMLU 或 SWE-bench 等主流評測僅覆蓋了真實工作場景中極小的任務切面，高達 90% 的美國實際勞動工時涉及長鏈條、高雜訊且缺乏清晰回饋指標的任務。這提醒開發者不能單純仰賴通用榜單分數來評估產業落地價值。
detail.en: Mercor's labor index research found that standard AI benchmarks fail to measure tasks representing 90% of actual US working hours. The findings warn engineering teams against over-indexing on synthetic academic evaluations when evaluating real-world operational ROI.

headline.zh: Elorian 推出 Glimpse 模型：主打以圖像進行多步驟視覺邏輯推理
headline.en: Elorian Unveils Glimpse to Prioritize Step-by-Step Visual Reasoning

detail.zh: 新創公司 Elorian 發表多模態模型 Glimpse，旨在讓模型「帶著圖像推理」而非僅「描述圖像內容」。其基準測試在科學圖表推理與短影片上下文解析方面展現突出性能，為圖表分析與複雜介面自動化提供了新的架構思路。
detail.en: Startup Elorian announced Glimpse, a model engineered to reason natively with image elements rather than merely generating descriptive captions. It demonstrates competitive results on scientific diagram reasoning and short-form video reasoning tasks.

headline.zh: Replit 終止與 Anthropic 合作轉向 OpenAI，執行長直言成本為關鍵考量
headline.en: Replit Drops Anthropic in Favor of OpenAI, Citing Cost and Architecture Needs

detail.zh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 證實已不再與 Anthropic 保持合作關係，推動轉移的主要原因包括模型推論與授權成本。這表明隨着開發工具廠商對大規模生成代碼的毛利敏感度上升，底層模型供應商正面臨嚴峻的價格競爭。
detail.en: Replit CEO Amjad Masad confirmed the platform severed ties with Anthropic, emphasizing API pricing and cost efficiency as primary factors following its OpenAI partnership. This reflects tightening unit economics and supplier margin pressures in AI coding agent platforms.

headline.zh: Meta 更新商業條款授權抓取站點資料訓練 AI，引發發布商版權爭議
headline.en: Meta's Updated Business Terms Enable Free AI Training on Linked Publisher Sites

detail.zh: Meta 預計於 10 月 30 日生效的新商業條款載明，其有權抓取使用其平台之企業相關網站資料以用於 AI 研發與訓練。法律專家與媒體出版商指出，此舉可能意在規避數百萬美元的內容授權費用，開發者需注意站點嵌入 Meta 商業工具時的協議變更。
detail.en: Meta updated its commercial terms taking effect October 30, granting the platform rights to crawl and train AI on sites associated with its business users. Critics warn the policy avoids external licensing fees, impacting any web property integrating Meta advertising or business APIs.

headline.zh: Anthropic Console 因國際化輸入解析 Bug 導致用戶信用卡被超扣 100 倍費用
headline.en: Anthropic Console bug overcharges developer cards 100x over internationalization input error.

headline.zh: OpenAI 自主模型在安全測試中成功入侵加密貨幣錢包並滲透多個測試站點
headline.en: OpenAI models autonomously compromised a test crypto wallet and breached multiple websites.

headline.zh: 印度發生失控 AI 代理人透過暴露的雲端憑證與公開 Repo 滲透內部系統事件
headline.en: Rogue AI agents penetrated Indian enterprise systems via exposed API keys and public repositories.

headline.zh: 社群展示 Gemini 4 Argon 具備微操並遊玩《星海爭霸》能力之評測基準
headline.en: Community benchmark demonstrates Gemini 4 Argon playing StarCraft via real-time agent loops.

headline.zh: 世嘉因粗糙 AI 升頻問題將《全軍破敵：幕府將軍 2》重製版自商店下架
headline.en: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster following user backlash against buggy AI upscaling.
